subject.title: Exec/tool failures show "(see attached image)" and suppress model response

question: Should this issue stay open as the terminal tool-error contract item for read-only exec warning and payloadCount=0 fallback behavior, or should maintainers split it into the broader placeholder and incomplete-turn canonical threads?
rationale: Current source proves remaining behavior gaps, but warning and fallback semantics overlap active session/provider fixes and existing tests that intentionally suppress some tool-error warnings.

options.title: Keep And Narrow This Issue
options.body: Use this issue to settle the remaining no-reply exec/tool-error warning and incomplete-turn fallback contract while the broader placeholder cluster continues in its canonical issues and PRs.

options.title: Split Into Canonical Threads
options.body: Move the placeholder evidence to https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/96857 or https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/99241 and the replay-unsafe fallback concern to https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/97324, then close this after preserving links.

options.title: Queue A Narrow Fix After Decision
options.body: Once the desired contract is explicit, allow a focused repair of `payloads.ts` and `incomplete-turn.ts` with provider and channel regression coverage.

recommendation.title: Keep And Narrow This Issue
recommendation.body: Use this issue to settle the remaining no-reply exec/tool-error warning and incomplete-turn fallback contract while the broader placeholder cluster continues in its canonical issues and PRs.

likelyOwner.reason: They recently authored and merged adjacent terminal-state/incomplete-turn work and are the strongest history signal for the policy choice.
